snapshot.hero_headline: The #1 AI meets the #1 CRM. Welcome to Claudeforce.
snapshot.hero_subhead: Claudeforce is a partnership between Salesforce and Anthropic to put your trusted data to work inside Claude — governed by the permissions and business rules your company already runs on. Our next innovation is Salesforce in Claude which ships as a plugin with 37 skills built for sellers, grounded in 27 years of Salesforce experience. It's available today for pilot customers and is planned for open beta in September 2026.
positioning_claims: The #1 AI meets the #1 AI CRM
An AI CRO for every seller
Grounded in 27 years of Salesforce experience
Probabilistic intelligence alone doesn't run a company; deterministic systems don't reason
Claude routes every action through Salesforce so business rules are enforced
Works with existing Salesforce permissions and business rules — no new permissions model
Admin connects once; whole team gets access day one
Zero data retention on Sonnet, Opus and Haiku
Claude is the default model for Slack
Salesforce is Anthropic's preferred CRM; Slack its preferred multiplayer work platform
Claude is the first LLM provider fully integrated within the Salesforce Trust Boundary
Slackbot driving 8.1M hours of annualized productivity gains, up over 2x quarter-over-quarter
Salesforce is customer zero — piloted by Salesforce and Anthropic sellers
Software is a system that powers every interface; the UI is the AI
